svg.title: How pg_pinecone works
svg.desc: An application sends pgvector SQL to Postgres, which keeps the rows and their vector column. pg_pinecone searches them with the native engine (the default, IVF plus RaBitQ, with a smaller index than HNSW and faster search at equal recall), the pgvector engine (HNSW or IVFFlat), or the remote engine, which runs on Pinecone: writes sync to a Pinecone serverless index and results come back.
